subject: Claire
responsibility: Index of rule identity and limit; full model prose owns support, contrary cases, conditions, confidence and disconfirmers.

rules.proposition: Accepted Iris-related task can restrain rank enforcement and support a conditional alliance.
rules.material_limit: Shared-interest pragmatism remains a rival; no universal egalitarian conversion.

rules.proposition: Favorable regard and protector identity can destabilize objection before a final choice.
rules.material_limit: Meeting refusals, office and perceived danger remain contrary to automatic assent.

rules.proposition: Technical skill coexists with an overbroad proxy in an unfamiliar task.
rules.material_limit: Ordinary novice information deficit remains a rival; no global low-intelligence claim.

rules.proposition: Gratitude and acknowledged benefit can coexist with imposed control under perceived threat.
rules.material_limit: Threat is sometimes real; neither gratitude nor warning supplies an automatic ethical veto.

rules.proposition: Recipient, act and affect alter stance, with functional shifts beyond generic noble politeness.
rules.material_limit: Printed forms do not establish Japanese generation, acoustic adequacy or universal taste.
